name: skyward-pushto
description: Offline push-to guidance and sensor testing for Ten Telescopes' Skyward 150 Compact and Skyward 200 Visual

scripts.test: node test/model.test.mjs && node test/check.test.mjs && node test/assist.test.mjs && node test/dome.test.mjs && node test/locate.test.mjs && node test/game.test.mjs && node test/eyeview.test.mjs && node test/plan.test.mjs
scripts.native:add: npm run copy:core && npx cap add ios; npx cap add android; node scripts/patch-native.mjs
scripts.sync: npm run copy:core && npx cap sync && node scripts/patch-native.mjs
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
